entity.summary: Decentralized cryptocurrency exchange on XPR Network using on-chain order books and non-custodial wallet-based trading, alongside AMM swap functionality in the broader Metal X product suite.
entity.notes: Current first-party documentation identifies Metal X as a decentralized exchange on XPR Network with on-chain order books, multiple order types, and user-controlled wallets. Independent exchange and protocol metrics report current markets and non-zero DEX volume. HEI treats the order-book DEX and related MetalX DEX trading surfaces as one protocol-level exchange entity rather than splitting product labels. An exact launch day, legal entity, or jurisdiction is not asserted.
